leadText:
Pikachu's Short Stories (Japanese: ピカチュウ短編集 Pikachu's Short Stories) is a graphic novel retelling the plotlines of various Pikachu shorts.

Volume 1 by Chuang Yi tells the story of PK01, PK04 and PK07. Volume 2 by Chuang Yi tells the story of PK10, PK11 and PK12.
